hook.say: Three midterms this week and you’ve got zero idea where to start.

beats.say: Your desk is a mountain of PDFs and scribbled slides you haven’t looked at since class.
Just snap a photo or drop the file into Kiln and let it turn everything into flashcards.
It builds exam‑style quizzes and pushes the cards you miss back into the mix faster.
Drop tonight’s lecture into Kiln, quiz yourself, and try to fall asleep with the answers fresh.
